text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis and these symptoms, I need to assess for signs of primary sclerosing cholangitis or other hepatobiliary issues. Do you currently have any jaundice, abdominal pain, or fever?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the MRCP is normal, ruling out primary sclerosing cholangitis, I need to investigate other causes of cholestasis such as autoimmune hepatitis. Have you noticed any joint pain, muscle weakness, or changes in your skin pigmentation?
